name: TeamViewer
description: A veteran enterprise remote-access and IT-support platform with deep corporate identity/security integrations — though many advanced features sit behind paid tiers.

Wayland Unattended Access.comment: Relies on standard APIs. Unattended access requires switching the system back to X11.

Relay Server.comment: Uses the vendor's own global router infrastructure as a fallback when P2P fails. Free for personal use, and included in the price for commercial licenses — but you cannot self-host your own relay server within a closed corporate network on standard plans.

Drawing Tablet Support.comment: Basic input works, but extended USB device passthrough with pressure sensitivity is unstable.

Adaptive Bitrate.comment: Behaves sluggishly: instead of smoothly adjusting the bitrate on the fly as the connection degrades, the session often freezes or drops frames abruptly.

Session Sharing.comment: Technically available, but on the free tier collaborative sessions are instantly cut off by commercial-use detection triggers.

Multi-User Sessions.comment: Full multi-user support is only available on Windows Server under expensive enterprise licenses (Tensor / Enterprise).

Virtual Display.comment: The virtual monitor feature is built in, but only available to holders of paid commercial licenses.

4:4:4 Chroma Subsampling.comment: Uses 4:2:0 chroma subsampling to save bandwidth.

Frame Rate (FPS).comment: Nominally rated up to 60 FPS, but in practice the heavy codec often drags the real frame rate down to 5-10 FPS.

Session Recording.comment: Manual local recording is included in the base tier, but centralized automatic session logging is only available on enterprise licenses.

Pre-Login Access.comment: Works via a background system service, but limited by commercial-use policy rules.

No Account Required.comment: Regular use requires an account, otherwise sessions are quickly flagged and blocked for 'suspected commercial use.'

SSO / OIDC.comment: Single sign-on integration (SAML, Azure AD) is only available on Tensor-tier licenses.

2FA / MFA.comment: Basic two-factor authentication is free, but enforced corporate 2FA policies require a paid license.

Address Book.comment: The basic contact list is heavily limited. Shared device groups and routing are paid-only features.

Audit Logs.comment: Detailed connection reports and the security audit console are included in enterprise plans.

Mass Deployment.comment: Silent deployment via MSI packages with assignment parameters (Assignment Tool) is not available in the free version.

RBAC.comment: Granular permission management, user profiles, and Conditional Access require the Tensor tier.

Privacy Mode (Black Screen).comment: Screen-blanking is only available with a commercial license (Business tier and above).

Remote Printing.comment: Requires a paid subscription for the virtual print driver to function.

Generic USB Passthrough.comment: Limited support; reliable operation with specific peripherals requires an enterprise plan.

File Manager UI.comment: The two-pane file manager is available for free, but is heavily monitored by algorithms for commercial-use detection.

Proxy Support.comment: Native HTTP and SOCKS proxy support in the client's network settings.

UAC Handling.comment: TeamViewer's background system service runs with SYSTEM privileges, allowing it to correctly display and handle UAC prompts on the Windows secure desktop.

Headless mode.comment: Mass deployment on headless servers (via MSI packaging) is only available with a corporate subscription.

Linux Wayland: Host.comment: Supported, but occasional limitations occur with system key passthrough or remote printing.

Android: Host.comment: Implemented via a separate TeamViewer Host app installed from Google Play.

Web Browser: Client.comment: Connections are available via the TeamViewer web portal.

Free Tier.comment: Personal use only. An aggressive heuristic algorithm is built in and frequently blocks sessions with a 'suspected commercial use' message.

Personal: Monthly.comment: Remote Access (Single User) plan. The price is quoted per month, but billing is exclusively annual — you must pay for all 12 months upfront.

Team / Business: Monthly.comment: Base business plan. Lets you administer a larger device fleet, but the number of simultaneous connection channels is strictly limited.

Enterprise.comment: Premium/Corporate/Tensor tier. This is the only level that includes independent parallel sessions, SSO, audit logs, and silent MSI deployment.
